note: What goes in a minion's slots. A minion has five slots but only three are worth asking about for a collection grind: one fuel and two upgrades. The fifth is a skin, which does nothing, and one upgrade slot is usually spent on a Super Compactor or a hopper to keep the minion from filling up - neither of which changes how much the minion collects, because compacting 160 cobblestone into an enchanted one still counts as 160 collected. Curated rather than scraped: both wiki tables are one page each and mix prose, ranges and per-minion exceptions, so a parser would be more fragile than the twenty rows it replaced.
source: Hypixel Wiki: Minion Fuel (list and the speed formula), Minion Upgrades (the upgrade table)
speedFormula: Time Between Actions = base / (1 + speedBoost). Stated on Minion Fuel, with a worked example: a Clay Minion XI has a base of 16s, and Enchanted Coal at +10% gives 16 / 1.10 = 14.55s. The scraped cooldown table gives Clay XI as exactly 16s, so the two agree.
multiplierNote: Fuels quoted as x2/x3/x4 do not touch the speed at all - they duplicate every item the minion produces. Kept as a separate field so the two are never added together.
extrasNote: Some upgrades change neither speed nor output and instead add a SECOND item to what the minion produces - Corrupt Soil, the Enchanted Egg, the Enchanted Shears, Diamond Spreading. They carry speed 0 and output 1 here because those fields are honest, and what they actually add lives in minion_extras.json. An upgrade with no effect in this file is not an upgrade with no effect.

fuels.name: Solar Panel
fuels.note: Infinite, but only works while a player is on the island and only in SkyBlock daytime unless paired with a Day Saver.

upgradeNote: Only the effects that change how fast a collection fills are modelled. A Compactor or Super Compactor 3000 changes the shape of the drop and not the count, so it is offered and modelled as no change - which is the honest answer, not an omission. Spreading upgrades generate a DIFFERENT item, so they do nothing for the collection you are grinding and are marked as such.

upgrades.name: Minion Expander
upgrades.note: Also widens the range to 7x7, which matters for mob minions rather than for resource ones. Two stack.

upgrades.name: Compactor
upgrades.note: Compacts drops into blocks. Does not change how much is collected - nine iron ingots compacted still count as nine.

upgrades.name: Super Compactor 3000
upgrades.note: Compacts drops into enchanted forms. Does not change how much is collected, but it is what stops a minion filling up and stalling.

upgrades.name: Dwarven Super Compactor
upgrades.note: Smelts and compacts. Same collection count.

upgrades.name: Diamond Spreading
upgrades.note: 10% chance of a Diamond per drop. That feeds the Diamond collection, not the one this minion is grinding.

upgrades.name: Corrupt Soil
upgrades.note: Corrupts every mob the minion spawns, adding 1 Sulphur and 1 Corrupted Fragment to each. Changes nothing about speed or the minion's own drop, and on a cheap mob minion the two extras are worth more than the drop itself - see minion_extras.json.

upgrades.name: Enchanted Egg
upgrades.note: Adds an Egg to each Chicken. Two while the island is loaded, one while it is not; this app models the unloaded case.

upgrades.name: Enchanted Shears
upgrades.note: Shears each sheep for an average of 2 Wool on top of the mutton.

upgrades.name: Soulflow Engine
upgrades.note: Halves the minion's output in exchange for Raw Soulflow. Wrong tool for a collection grind, and included so the cost of using it is visible.
